verdict.rationale: Bun documents first-party CLI commands for the whole lifecycle: `bun add` for adding packages, `bun remove` (which removes the package from every dependency group in package.json and updates bun.lock), and `bun update`/`bun up` (with an `--interactive` option) for upgrading. Supporting commands also rewrite bun.lock: `bun dedupe` saves it and audit fix upgrades vulnerable packages, so an agent never needs to hand-edit these files. missing for 10: explicit documentation that `bun add` and `bun update` write package.json and bun.lock (the snippets only show this for remove and dedupe), independent or hands-on corroboration that these rewrites are safe.
